Verdika

See what people experience. Put what needs fixing in front of the right people.

Discuss a deployment↗See how it works ↓

Verdika turns feedback, ratings and votes into clear patterns and accountable next actions. It can be configured to send relevant feedback to the responsible stakeholder. Its public civic application lets people rate public leaders and institutions and state what they want changed.

Who it is for

Businesses, institutions and public bodies that need to understand customer, employee or public experience.
